parameters.name: GroupDesc
parameters.description: The description of the group. The description can be up to 100 characters in length. Each Chinese character counts as one character.

parameters.name: GroupName
parameters.description: The name of the group. The name must be 4 to 30 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, and underscores (_). Each Chinese character counts as two characters.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Overview** page or </ph></props>ID is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: SuperGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the parent group.

If you want to create a top-level group, do not specify this parameter.
